note: Resolution of the last 36 pending questions, settled against the actual law text (Igazeti / Code de la Route, extracted and searched). Every one of the 5 'ambiguous' items turned out to match its original source-marked answer — the AI verifier was wrong on all five. One of my own medium-confidence resolutions was wrong and is corrected here.

lawVerified.quote: Ku ntera ya metero 100 ku binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, iyo ntera igashobora kungana na Metero 50, iyo umuvuduko w'ibinyabiziga bidapakiye udashobora kurenga kirometero 50 mu isaha ahategamye.
lawVerified.why: The stem is exactly the reduced case, so 50m is right.

lawVerified.quote: L'intervalle entre les vehicules automobiles formant un convoi en vue d'un trajet a faire de concert doit etre d'au moins 30 metres.
lawVerified.why: 30m between vehicles; the 50m figure applies between GROUPS, which is what the verifier confused it with.

lawVerified.quote: Amatara maremare y'ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa: a) Iyo umuhanda umurikiwe hose bihagije ... muri metero zigeze ku 100; b) Iyo ikinyabiziga kigiye kubisikana n'ikindi ...
lawVerified.why: Option A quotes 200m where the law says 100m, and 'in a built-up area' is not a listed case, so only B holds.

lawVerified.quote: Ahanyura abayobozi b'amagare ... haciye imirongo ibiri icagaguye igizwe na kare cyangwa ingirwamwashi by'ibara ryera.
lawVerified.why: The law says squares OR lozenges, so 'both' is correct.

lawVerified.quote: Les signaux sont places aux endroits les plus appropries eu egard a la nature de l'indication qu'ils fournissent.
lawVerified.why: Placement follows the nature of what the sign indicates — the marked answer.

corrections.why: Ingingo ya 42: rear fog lamps may only be used when visibility drops below 100m, not 50m. My earlier resolution was wrong.
corrections.explanation: Amatara kamena-bihu y'inyuma ntashobora gukoreshwa keretse iyo kubona neza bidashoboka hirya ya **metero 100** (igihu, imvura nyinshi n'ibindi). Ingingo ya 42 y'amategeko y'umuhanda ni yo ibiteganya — igisubizo ni **B**.

optionNotes.C: m50 ni nke; itegeko rivuga metero 100.
optionNotes.D: Hari igisubizo cy'ukuri, ari cyo B (m100).
